notes: Full course selected from the complete closed OpenStreetMap way1061184414v1, compared with native satellite imagery and the operator facility map. Internal circulation shortcuts in the prior provisional cycle are excluded. Coordinates remain exact retained source nodes; no nominal length or width fit. Direction follows the operator map. Source geometry remains draft; border and terrain limits remain estimates.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 51 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Road limits derived from a road-local-appearance-v4 pixel proposal on the corrected exact OSM full course. Native full-course overlay, rectified sections, curves and junctions visually reviewed. Shadow-affected stations60-160 and460-600 fit curves through separately visible native-image edge reads (80,100,140,480,500,520,540,560,580), supported by their road/grass colour transitions; the fully shaded100-140 segment remains an inferred join. The fitted controls are not independent observations; the main-road/pit opening around740-10 uses an inferred join and an approximate image-read station0 limit. These joins are estimates. Dense paired reconstruction controls freeze the reviewed image proposal and are not independent manual observations. Roughly1-2m reading precision; no nominal road width, official-length fit or surveyed boundaries. Curbs illustrative and banking unknown.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed from complete pairs of sparse image-edge measurements. Each pair defines its own road section; the original trace is preserved and constrains station displacement and route order. Linear intervals, junction openings and curbs remain estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. No automatic evidence scores are claimed.
